Export actual scientific figures and a provenance-linked publication report

Source: R/research-publication-report.R
aqt_research_publish.Rd

Uses the exact precomputed aqt_scientific_analysis, emits only evidence- supported figures, and records withheld figures and errors. Existing native plotting helpers are reused for school dispersion and independent-tank changes; other plots draw directly from already gap-audited numerical data. PNG plus vector PDF and a self-contained report/evidence archive are produced without introducing new numerical estimates.

Usage

aqt_research_publish(
  study,
  directory,
  formats = c("png", "pdf"),
  width = 7.8,
  height = 5.8,
  dpi = 220L,
  max_scopes = 3L,
  data_origin = c("unspecified", "synthetic", "real")
)

Arguments

study

Source-verified aqt_scientific_analysis.

directory

New output folder; parent directory must already exist.

formats

Unique nonempty selection of png or pdf.

width, height

Physical figure dimensions in inches (3..15).

dpi

PNG resolution in dots/inch, 100..600.

max_scopes

Maximum distinct camera/session figure groups, 1..8.

data_origin

Declared origin: unspecified, synthetic or real.

Value

Output directory invisibly.
